scope: Four deliberately inconsistent metadata configurations at each of4/8/16/32 input counts, one output per invocation. Synthetic packed-14 pixels; radial correction disabled.
variants: First input ISO3200; every remaining input ISO3201.
First input ISO3201; every remaining input ISO3200.
All inputs ISO3200; first selects rows12..17, remaining inputs select rows40..45.
All inputs ISO3200; first input has no selected rows, remaining inputs select rows12..17.

result.counterfactual: Apply the ISO and selector from a remaining input to the whole sequence instead of the first input.

confirmed: The standalone DLL accepts these inconsistent input groups.
ISO branch selection and the24-byte sparse-selection descriptor come from the first ABI input of the current output group.
Sixteen-frame mode reuses that descriptor for all four four-frame preprocessing groups.
Eight/thirty-two modes reuse it for all two-frame pairs.
Later input metadata does not override the first input in these tested fields.
static_evidence: Worker0x350590 loads ISO from context+0x1d0 and selector from context+0x1f0 before mode dispatch; those are first-frame fields. Mode16 and32 loops advance source vectors while retaining this descriptor.
native_implication: A native CLI should validate capture coherence explicitly. Successful vendor execution does not prove that input files belong to one valid sequence or share compatible settings.
limitations: Other varying fields, including dimensions, crop, white balance, camera identity, compression, group identifiers and actual sequence phase, are not covered here.
This invokes the standalone DLL directly and does not measure NX Studio UI validation.
No authentic capture or Lightroom acceptance is implied.
